# KILN LEDGER

- Project: a pottery studio archive across three years
- Collection owner: KILN LEDGER
- Record source: KILN LEDGER studio records
- Snapshot date: 2026-08-31
- Record years: 2024, 2025, 2026
- Collection size: 8 distinct pieces
- Permanent IDs: KL-001 through KL-008
- Named firing batches: B24-01, B24-02, B25-01, B26-01
- Archive name: KILN LEDGER
- Missing-value label: Missing
- Source credit: Source: KILN LEDGER studio records, 2024-2026

## Record structure

| Core field | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| Piece ID | Permanent identifier for one physical piece |
| Photograph | One image filename assigned to the piece ID |
| Vessel form | Bowl, Cup, Vase or Plate |
| Glaze category | One or more of Ash, Iron and Clear; semicolons separate multiple labels |
| Firing batch | Recorded batch identifier |
| Finished status | Finished or Second |
| Record date | Date the piece record was entered; basis for annual grouping |

- Browsing facets: vessel form, glaze category, firing batch, finished status, record date
- Missing: an absent recorded value
- Finished: studio stock accepted as finished work
- Second: studio stock retained as a second
- Complete record: all seven core fields populated
- Complete records: 5 of 8
- Complete-record percentage: 5 ÷ 8 × 100 = 62.5%
- Incomplete records: 3 of 8
- Distinct-piece count: number of unique piece IDs in the selected group
- Glaze membership: one piece ID paired with one recorded glaze label
- Recorded glaze memberships: 9 across 7 distinct pieces
- Multi-label pieces: KL-002 and KL-005
- Missing glaze category: KL-006
- Missing firing batch: KL-007
- Missing finished status: KL-008
- Batch comparison scope: distribution of recorded finished statuses
- Counts unit: pieces
- Glaze association unit: glaze memberships
- Completeness percentage unit: %

steps.userMessage:
KILN LEDGER | A pottery studio archive across three years

Our studio needs a visual archive that helps us return to individual pots as readily as we compare years of work. The first collection contains 8 pieces recorded from 2024 through 2026, across 4 named firing batches. Build the archive around the existing photographs and permanent piece IDs KL-001 through KL-008. Print "KILN LEDGER" on the image index, sample detail pages, browsing example, summary and presentation.

The structure is fixed: vessel form, glaze category, firing batch, finished status and record date. A piece can carry several glaze labels; totals count distinct piece IDs. Five of the 8 records have all seven core fields populated, giving 62.5% complete records. Display absent values as "Missing". Use Ash #0072B2, Iron #E69F00, Clear #CC79A7 and Missing #666666 for category encoding, with direct labels that remain readable in grayscale. Describe batch comparisons as distributions of recorded outcomes. Our tablet viewing area measures 240 × 135 mm in landscape and 135 × 240 mm in portrait; the printed summary is A4 portrait with 12 mm margins.

Audience: studio potters and learners, choosing how to organise accumulated work, retrieve related pieces and prioritise incomplete records.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the collection facts, field definitions and fixed category colours. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists every deliverable with its proportion, format and stage. 03-piece-records.en.md contains the piece records, photograph assignments, missing-field notes and aggregate tables as of 2026-08-31. archive-surfaces.png supplies the tablet viewing areas and printed-page geometry. kl-001.png identifies the ash-glazed bowl. kl-002.png identifies the cup with ash and iron glaze areas. kl-003.png identifies the iron-glazed vase. kl-004.png identifies the clear-glazed plate. kl-005.png identifies the bowl with ash and clear glaze areas. kl-006.png identifies the cup whose glaze category is missing from its record. kl-007.png identifies the iron-glazed vase whose firing batch is missing. kl-008.png identifies the clear-glazed plate whose finished status is missing. studio-browsing.png provides the atmosphere of a working archive wall and tablet station.

Deliverables:
1. A two-page data summary and chart inventory defining the seven core fields, permanent-ID and multi-label counting rules, category colours, and each chart's data columns, chart type, units, carrier and printed wording
2. One landscape image index containing all 8 photographs, their piece IDs and the five browsing facets
3. Two classification sheets: vessel forms and glaze categories, with counts and matching piece thumbnails
4. Two distribution sheets: firing batches with finished-status breakdowns, and annual piece counts
5. One vessel-form-to-glaze relationship sheet with labelled intersections and the contributing piece IDs
6. One record-completeness sheet with the complete-record calculation and the three incomplete records
7. Two sample detail pages, for KL-002 and KL-007, each containing its photograph, seven core fields and links by shared category or batch
8. One portrait browsing example tracing Ash to KL-002 and then to the other piece in batch B24-01
9. One A4 collection summary containing the annual totals, glaze membership counts and complete-record calculation
10. One 10-second archive walkthrough video following the portrait browsing example
11. One presentation document of at least 8 pages, reusing the data summary, coding rules, index, charts, detail pages and browsing sequence

Acceptance:
- The data summary and chart inventory state 8 pieces, 62.5% complete records and the source credit "Source: KILN LEDGER studio records, 2024-2026". Repeat all three on the landscape image index, portrait browsing example, A4 summary and presentation; every chart carries that source credit, a title, its unit and one reading annotation. Every plotted value comes from the records or aggregate tables in 03-piece-records.en.md.
- The image index and classification sheets pair each thumbnail with the ID assigned to its photograph. The KL-002 and KL-007 detail pages reproduce their respective records, and the browsing example and video follow Ash → KL-002 → B24-01 → KL-001 using those same photographs.
- The classification and distribution sheets show 2 pieces per vessel form; annual totals of 3, 3 and 2 for 2024, 2025 and 2026; and batch totals of 2, 1, 3 and 1 for B24-01, B24-02, B25-01 and B26-01, plus 1 Missing. The glaze sheet, relationship sheet and A4 summary show Ash 3, Iron 3 and Clear 3 as 9 glaze memberships across 7 pieces, alongside 1 piece with Missing glaze and an archive total of 8 distinct pieces.
- The completeness sheet and A4 summary display 5 ÷ 8 × 100 = 62.5%. The completeness sheet identifies KL-006: glaze category, KL-007: firing batch and KL-008: finished status. The relationship sheet labels connections as glaze membership; the batch distribution sheet describes the recorded Finished, Second and Missing counts within each batch.
- The data summary, glaze classification sheet, relationship sheet and presentation use Ash #0072B2, Iron #E69F00, Clear #CC79A7 and Missing #666666 consistently. Every chart names its categories directly, and every quantitative axis begins at zero.
- The landscape index and portrait browsing example fit the respective tablet areas; the A4 summary retains 12 mm margins. The video lasts 10 seconds. The presentation contains at least 8 pages and repeats the seven-field structure and complete-record calculation from the opening data summary.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
